==Behind the scenes==
This book is the in-universe equivalent to the real-world book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'', which was written by [[Ann Margaret Lewis (real person)|Ann Margaret Lewis]] and [[Helen Keier]], and published by [[Del Rey]] in [[2006]].
